metadata.description: Claude Code plugins and mods made by anderson-spider.

plugins.name: chatgpt
plugins.description: Ask ChatGPT or generate requested images in a logged-in browser; save results locally.

plugins.name: codex-computer-use
plugins.description: Control native Mac apps through Codex, with per-app approval and /codex-cu on|off.

plugins.name: coolify
plugins.description: Read or change your Coolify instance (projects, applications, deployments) through its API, using the url and apiKey plugin options.

plugins.name: gitlab
plugins.description: Work on GitLab merge requests and pipelines of the current repository, picking the host and token from its git remote.

plugins.name: session-hud
plugins.description: A card above the prompt: model, context and cache; the five-hour and seven-day limits with their pace; the running subagents with their type, model and effort, and the tokens they used; what the last turn sent and added, edits and errors.

plugins.name: tailscale
plugins.description: Read or change your tailnet through the Tailscale API using the apiKey plugin option.
